title: Red Cat Ramen Anime's 2nd Season Reveals More Cast, January 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the anime adaptation of ANGYAMAN 's Red Cat Ramen ( Ramen Akaneko ) manga revealed on Saturday the second season will debut in January 2027. The website also revealed the new season's staff, one new cast member, a teaser visual, and a teaser video.
author: ANN

title: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! Anime's Teaser Unveils Cast, Staff, October Debut
content: Kadokawa presented a teaser promotional video and a teaser visual for the television anime of writer Eiko Mutsuhana and illustrator Vient 's Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion! light novel series on Saturday. The teaser announces the anime's cast, staff, and October premiere.
author: ANN

title: 'Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu.' Reveals Main Cast, Staff for Fall 2026
content: The official website of the Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu. ( Hi, I'm a Witch, and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion ) television anime revealed the main cast, staff, and a teaser promo on Saturday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 30 Years Later, One of The Greatest Shonen Jump Classics Is Finally Returning With a New Series
content: Even decades later, there’s just something undeniably special about ‘90s anime . It wasn’t just the stories or the characters that set the era apart, it was the entire aesthetic. The warm, slightly grainy visuals, the hand-drawn animation, and the raw emotion in every scene made these shows truly timeless.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Is Finally Streaming Beloved Fantasy Film Fans Have Been Waiting For
content: Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid is returning to screens with a new movie currently hitting theaters throughout Japan later this month , and now fans in North America will be able to watch Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid: A lonely dragon wants to be loved , soon for themselves soon enough too.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Best Mystery Series Confirms Sequel Release Date With a New Look
content: As the largest streaming platform for anime fans around the world, Crunchyroll is home to many incredible anime series and films. Each anime season, the platform brings dozens of new series and sequels of fan-favorite shows.
author: ComicBook

title: Acclaimed 1990s Classic Unveils Main Trailer For Anime Revival
content: For several decades, the anime and manga industry has been heavily dominated by the Shonen demographic, and most of the mainstream series are purely battle action. Most of the best-selling manga of all time are also Shonen series, including One Piece, Naruto, Dragon Ball, Demon Slayer, and many more.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Finally Confirms Streaming Dandadan Studio’s Most Anticipated Anime
content: Established in 2013, the animation studio Science SARU is famous for crafting visually striking anime with deeply captivating storylines. The studio’s flagship series is Dandadan , a hit Shonen Jump series, which debuted in 2024.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Yami Shibai' 17th Season Announced for Summer 2026
content: Television station TV Tokyo announced a 17th season for the Yami Shibai short horror anime series on Friday. The official website also revealed the staff, cast, key visual (pictured), and the theme song. The new season—centered on the theme of "Ketsu" (Decision)—will begin airing on July 12 on TV Tokyo.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Major Shonen Jump Series to End After Only 2 Years
content: Shonen Jump has been the premier publication for the biggest manga in the world, housing the likes of Dragon Ball, One Piece, Jujutsu Kaisen, My Hero Academia , and too many other stories to count.
author: ComicBook
